name: delpha
description: Verify commercial identity for AI agents: which company a record refers to, its commercial parent and its business contacts, via the Delpha MCP server and agent skills

interface.longDescription:
Delpha helps AI agents verify commercial identity: which company a record refers to, the commercial group it belongs to, and its business contact details. Results include validation findings, confidence scores and supporting evidence where available, helping teams assess records before taking action.

Delpha uses a company's website alongside other identity signals to distinguish companies with similar names and assess their commercial relationships.

What you can do with Delpha:
• Resolve a company's commercial parent and distinguish it from its legal or financial parent
• Validate a company's website, LinkedIn page and legal identifier
• Find and verify a person's LinkedIn profile and business email
• Validate and normalize a phone number or name you already hold
• Assess new-logo and account-routing decisions when existing CRM account information is provided

Built for RevOps, sales and data teams. The tools look up, validate and normalize data; they do not modify your CRM. Applying changes requires a separate CRM integration. Results can be incomplete or uncertain and should be assessed using the returned evidence and confidence information. Requires a Delpha account with MCP access enabled at app.delpha.ai.

People data: Delpha holds no contact database. Email candidates come from name and company-domain patterns, LinkedIn profiles from public web search, and phone checks from verification providers. Data sources and privacy details: https://help.delpha.io/delpha-api-and-mcp/api/data-sources-and-privacy
capabilities: Resolve a company's commercial ultimate parent, ownership chain and financial parent
Assess new-logo and existing-account routing using supplied CRM account context
Find or validate a company's canonical website
Validate an email address's deliverability and qualify its domain
Find a person's professional email from their name and company website
Validate and normalize a phone number (E.164, line type, carrier, time zone)
Validate and normalize a person's name and flag swapped or misspelled fields
Find or validate a person's LinkedIn profile or a company's LinkedIn page
Find or validate a company's supported registry identifier, such as SIRET, SIREN, ABN or CIK
